sentences.text:
The present interlocutory application is filed  seeking suspension of the sentence of  imprisonment imposed against the petitioner/
 accused for the offence punishable under  Sections 376 r/w 511 and 323 of IPC in  S.C.No.54 of 2018 on the file of V Additional  District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court  for Trial of Offences Against Women, West  Godavari, Eluru.

The petitioner is sentenced to  undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of  five years and to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/- for the  offence under Section 376 r/w 511 of IPC and in  default of payment of fine, he has to undergo  simple imprisonment for a period of one year and  he was further sentenced to undergo simple  imprisonment for a period of six months and also  to pay a fine of Rs.500/- for the offence under Section 323 of IPC in default of payment of fine,
 he has to undergo simple imprisonment for a  period of two months.
Heard Sri MRK Chakravarthy, learned  counsel for the petitioner and Ms.K.Priyanka  Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner has been in jail for the last two years and they have good grounds to succeed in the Appeal.
Learned counsel finally prays to allow the petition by imposing any condition to ensure the presence of the petitioner/accused before this court.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.

In that view, considering the submissions made and taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, as the present appeal Nijaparapu Satyanarayana Sattiyya vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102214880/
1 may take some considerable time for disposal, it is apposite to allow this interlocutory application by suspending the sentence of imprisonment imposed against the petitioner, pending disposal of the appeal on the following terms:
1.
The petitioner/accused shall execute personal bond for Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties for a like sum each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge.
2.
